about.heroBio: A psychological counselor and CBT specialist dedicated exclusively to women and teenage girls. Certified at the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah, and a descendant of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ — her work is rooted in deep spiritual trust, clinical precision, and unwavering compassion.
about.heroQuote:
Fear is natural — but staying trapped in the spiral of fear is not destiny.
When a person learns how to hold her feelings and organize her thoughts…
calm returns to the heart.
about.storyP1: For over 20 years, Alia AlBahri has worked in the field of psychological counseling and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy — not as a career choice, but as a calling. She founded Al Yasmine Center with a single belief: that every woman deserves access to grounded, evidence-based support that honors both her mind and her spirit.
about.storyP2: Based in Dubai and working across the Arab world, Alia combines clinical precision with deep human understanding. Her approach is practical, warm, and rooted in the latest CBT methodologies — designed to help women build lasting psychological balance, not just temporary relief.
about.silsilaBody: Alia holds an unbroken chain of Islamic knowledge transmission traced back to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. This spiritual foundation is not separate from her clinical work — it is woven into it. Her clients find in her a rare combination: a certified psychologist who understands the soul as deeply as she understands the mind.
about.cbtCard1Body: CBT helps you identify patterns of thinking that keep you feeling stuck, anxious, or overwhelmed.
about.cbtCard2Title: Change the Pattern, Change the Feeling
about.cbtCard2Body: Practical, proven tools to interrupt cycles of anxiety and fear before they take hold.
about.cbtCard3Body: Builds long-term resilience and emotional regulation — not dependency on sessions.
about.cred1Desc: Specialized postgraduate qualification in CBT-based psychological counseling.
about.cred2Desc: Certified Professional Trainer (CPT) accredited by the British Board and endorsed by the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA), Dubai.
about.cred3Desc: Over two decades of clinical experience in CBT, trauma therapy, and child and adolescent counseling across Dubai and the Arab world.
about.cred4Desc: More than 1,000 consulting hours and 2,000 training hours delivered across leading centers in Dubai, including in collaboration with the Dubai Community Development Authority.

testimonials.quote: I personally reaped incredible benefits and applied so many of the techniques and strategies in my home. The results were stunning — the positive impact exceeded all my expectations. I wholeheartedly recommend attending the course, staying focused, and practising what you learn.

My pen falls short of writing words to thank you for the course that lit the lanterns of my heart and my home. Subhan'Allah, since the course I've been living in a state of calm and stability. At home, I used to check my husband's phone constantly — I never confronted him, I bottled everything inside until I developed high blood pressure and started taking out my stress on my children. Subhan'Allah, your course helped me understand what I truly need before trying to understand my husband's and children's needs. Now I deal with them using all the wonderful techniques you taught us. Wallahi, from my heart, I love you so much. Thank you, thank you.

My feeling… I am so deeply happy. Before, I felt the surahs of the Quran were distant — like I needed a long journey to reach each one. Now I feel all the surahs are right before me at once, and I feel the lightness of the Quran in my hands, the complete opposite of how I felt before this wonderful course. Alhamdulillah, by Allah's grace. I thank you all, and insha'Allah may it be in the scale of your good deeds. May Allah benefit Islam and the Muslims through you.

I created this group because of the benefit that Allah brings through Ustadha Alia Al-Bahiri, may Allah preserve her. In short, chaos has spread in our time because of those who speak about parenting and psychology without proper evidence or Islamic grounding — despite the need to benefit from research and studies in this field that align with Shariah. I found this in Dr. Alia, because she combines academic study with ijazah in the Holy Quran — far from the pretenders who think that by attending a few courses and learning presentation skills and the art of persuasion, they have become 'coaches.'

freeCoursePage.modulesBody: Each module takes under 30 minutes. Work through them at your own pace before your first session.
freeCoursePage.module1Body: Explore your core values, beliefs, and the patterns that have shaped your journey so far.
freeCoursePage.module2Body: Learn how to set goals that are truly aligned with who you are and where you want to go.
freeCoursePage.module3Body: Identify and begin to dismantle the stories that have been holding you back from your potential.
freeCoursePage.module4Body: Create gentle rituals and habits that support your growth between sessions.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.section1Body: When you use Al Yasmine Center's website or book a session, we may collect personal information including your name, email address, phone number, and any information you share during sessions. We collect this information only when you voluntarily provide it.
privacyPage.section2Body: We use your information to provide our services, communicate with you about your sessions, send relevant updates if you have opted in, and improve our offering. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacyPage.section3Body: All information shared during sessions is treated with strict confidentiality in accordance with professional ethics. Session content will not be disclosed to any third party without your explicit written consent, except where required by law.
privacyPage.section4Body: Your data is stored securely and we implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect it against unauthorised access, alteration, or disclosure.
privacyPage.section5BodyBefore: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at
privacyPage.section6BodyBefore: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at

termsPage.heading: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.section1Body: Al Yasmine Center provides psychological consultation and CBT-based therapeutic services for women and teenage girls. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact a qualified mental health professional or local emergency services.
termsPage.section2Body: Sessions must be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours notice may be charged in full. No-shows are charged at the full session rate.
termsPage.section3Body: Payment is due prior to or at the time of each session unless a package has been agreed upon. All prices are in AED and include applicable taxes where required.
termsPage.section4BodyBefore: We offer a full refund if you are not satisfied after your first session — no questions asked. For packages, unused sessions may be refunded on a pro-rata basis within 14 days of purchase. To request a refund, email us at
termsPage.section5Body: All materials, workbooks, and content provided by Al Yasmine Center are for personal use only and may not be reproduced or distributed without written permission.
termsPage.section6BodyBefore: For any questions, reach us at
